product_one_liner.value: Marquee is an AI-native football decision layer for professional clubs, turning internal and external football data into decision-ready insights for recruitment, squad planning and analytics.

pricing_page.notes: The public site presents an early-access/demo request rather than a pricing page.

eng_blog.notes: The news index is primarily product, partnership, press and events content; it shows one clearly technical build-focused article rather than the two-plus engineering-post threshold.

public_docs.notes: The homepage exposes early-access/demo and FAQ content but no public documentation or developer/help portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A Senior AI Scientist role was advertised on 2026-11-03.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed public product, FAQ, technical and security materials describe proprietary AI/ML models but do not name an external model provider.

raised_18mo.notes: The $6.5M seed announcement is dated 2026-07-30, within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The accessible current hiring evidence identifies an AI-science role, not an SDR, BDR or account-executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: Marquee published the Squad Fit product/model feature article on 2026-09-25, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company profile shows VP-level additions in the window, including VP R&D Gad Sharon (joined July 2026) and VP Data & AI Yuval Foox (announced September 2026).

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable hiring and product pages reviewed name no CRM or sales/marketing system.
